_comment: Escalation (R2-B), read by campaign/escalation.gd. Each act has three alert tiers, from tiers[0]. Holding thresholds[i].held / thresholds[i].of of the act's regions (rounded up) raises the alert to tier i + 1; the escalation variant (data/variants/variants.json) may give its own thresholds. Tiers never drop within an act; each act starts at tiers[0]. A hostile region fights at its own defense plus its tier's level_offset, kept within min_level and max_level, plus its fortification, at most 5. The faction tables (data/combat/factions.json tier_by_act) turn that level into the enemy unit tier, so the bands below are what tie alert tier to enemy tier. fortify: from tier from_tier on (0 is the first tier), each hostile region left alone gains one fortification level every days_per_level days, at most max_levels; attacking it restarts its count, capturing it clears it. news: headlines per act and tier (tier 0 has none, a run starts there) and for a region reaching max_levels; {map}, {tier}, {region} and {count} are filled in. The headline shown is picked by the day, so a run is deterministic. ui: how long a news card stays up and how wide it is. Every number here is a first guess, not balance.
